query.description: The exploration question from the parent agent, e.g. 'List the key files involved in the voice typing start-recording flow, with the relevant functions in each'.

project_path.description: Path to the project root to explore. Required. May be absolute or relative to the bs-ai-config.json directory. The explorer agent scopes all search/read tools under this root.

provider.description: Optional provider override. Defaults to explore_project.default_provider.

model.description: Optional model override. Must support tool calling (supports_tools: true). Defaults to explore_project.default_model.

system_prompt.description: Optional override for the explorer LLM system prompt. Defaults to the body of the configured .skills/<skill_name>.md (explorer.md).

temperature.description: Optional temperature override for the explorer LLM.

max_iterations.description: Optional cap on the explorer agent's tool-calling loop. Defaults to explore_project.max_iterations.
